flags.why: The cupboard sense is regional, especially in Central Vietnamese, rather than merely uncommon nationwide ([regional usage](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cụi)).

The gloss incorrectly limits bánh rán to sweet mung-bean filling, although savoury versions are also familiar everyday foods ([example](https://vnexpress.net/banh-ran-nhan-man-cho-bua-sang-3248242.html)).
flags.fix: fried glutinous rice cake with a sweet or savoury filling

flags.why: Using bới for scooping rice is mainly Central and Southern usage and needs regional labels ([Central usage](https://www.art2all.net/chantran/chantran_tho/tranngocbao/tudienphuongnguhue/tudienphuongnguhue_B.htm)).
